description: At Kapture CX, we are looking for an Associate Product Manager in our Product team. Who are we? Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation. Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia. What is this role all about? Dive into the heart of product innovation where you'll shape cutting-edge AI-driven CX solutions, collaborate with top talent, and drive real impact for global enterprises—all while accelerating your growth in product management. Sounds interesting? Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role: Collaborate with senior product managers and stakeholders to define bold product visions, strategies, and roadmaps that propel Kapture forward. Dive deep into market research and competitor analysis, uncovering trends, customer needs, and game-changing opportunities for enhancements. Gather and document razor-sharp product requirements from stakeholders, customers, and feedback, turning insights into actionable plans. Partner with UX/UI teams to craft intuitive designs that deliver exceptional user experiences, then coordinate with engineering for seamless, high-impact launches. Analyze performance metrics and user feedback to fuel data-driven decisions, while testing features and maintaining crystal-clear communication across teams. This is a Bengaluru-based role. Here are the basic requirements: Hold a bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, with 2+ years of experience in product management, SaaS, or related roles. Demonstrate strong analytical skills and familiarity with product metrics, market research tools, and customer feedback processes. Show proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and stakeholder teams. Bring excellent communication skills to document requirements, updates, and launches effectively. What are the most critical skills for this role? Master market research and competitor analysis to spot opportunities and translate them into product strategies. Excel at gathering, prioritizing, and documenting product requirements from diverse sources. Coordinate effortlessly with UX/UI, engineering, and other teams to ensure on-time, high-quality deliveries. Analyze metrics and feedback to drive iterative improvements and informed decisions. You will have an advantage if you: Have hands-on experience with AI-powered SaaS products or CX platforms. Are skilled in tools like Jira, Figma, or analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude). Bring prior exposure to agile methodologies or product testing/validation processes. Have built relationships across sales, marketing, and customer success for successful launches. Why should you be interested? Here’s what you will gain from this role: Hands-on experience shaping AI-driven products for global enterprises, fast-tracking your product management career. Collaboration with industry leaders in a high-growth SaaS environment, plus mentorship from senior PMs. Ownership of impactful features used by Fortune 500 clients, with clear paths to promotion. A vibrant Bangalore office culture with perks like flexible growth opportunities and innovation-driven projects. Does this sound like you? Click the Apply button to let us know!

description: Always wanted to build the systems behind one of Europe's most advanced supply chains? As part of this Graduate Program, you'll own part of Picnic's supply chain tech products from day one. You'll be end-to-end responsible for developing products that power our operations by understanding operational challenges, analyzing data, working with business teams, designing solutions with engineers, and validating impact through experiments and analytics. You're the one making it happen. The program at Picnic is one of the most ambitious tracks in the industry: from recent graduate to Product Manager. Wondering what problems you’ll work on? Think optimising how items are picked in our automated fulfilment center, decreasing waste by optimal ordering, designing a flow how we make sure coolpacks for chilled deliveries get back to the fulfilment center or integrating with robots to automate our operations even more. What You'll Be Doing Over 18 months you'll learn everything it takes to build a great product by actually doing it. You'll work alongside experienced product managers in our team. You will spend your program embedded deeply in one supply chain domain to see the long-term impact of your products, with options to expand scope into adjacent domains as you scale after 18 months. Every 3 months, you will reflect on your growth and define new learning goals with your mentor to grow you into the Product Manager role as fast as possible. 0-6 months You learn how to solve operational and internal user problems. From day one, you’ll help build features used by thousands of users, while getting to know our product end to end. To understand what to build, you’ll analyze operational processes through data analysis and interviews. Based on your learnings you’ll help shape new features. 6-12 months You build your first features from scratch. This is the first time you'll own the full product development lifecycle. With the help of an experienced Product Manager, you’ll scope a supply chain problem, shape the solution across design, engineering, data, and business. You’ll drive execution on your plan, ship to customers & see the direct impact of your work. 12+ months You own a product scope end to end. You decide what problems to solve and own the solutions: the research, the analyses, the designs, the stakeholders, the tech. You are in the lead and responsible for the outcome. The Program The launchpad to Product Manager. Learn everything there is about building product & become a PM twice as fast as the industry standard. Ownership from day one. You’ll immediately work on improving our Supply Chain, alongside our experienced product teams. You’ll get to experience different scopes ranging from warehouse operations to ordering inbound and from optimal planning of deliveries and routing to our in-house built apps used by thousands of our operational colleagues. Tangible impact: Every feature you ship is measured, so you'll see the exact impact of your decisions in real data. If it works, double down. If it doesn't, own it and iterate. Mentorship: You'll have a dedicated mentor accelerating your growth. Your mentor will grow you as a Product Manager, and also be your guide into the domain. But most of what you learn, you learn by actually doing it. Who Are You We’re looking for future leaders who are hungry to learn, eager to build, and passionate about our mission. description: Jij ziet verder dan alleen een mechanisch ontwerp. Jij begrijpt hoe mechanica, elektrotechniek, PLC-software, sensoren en documentatie samen één product vormen. Je bent de schakel tussen de techniek, productontwikkeling en business. Daarbij verbind je disciplines als Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, PLC, Supply Chain, Productie, Service en Sales. Je creëert overzicht, brengt structuur aan en zorgt ervoor dat productinformatie, eigenaarschap en wijzigingen goed worden geborgd. Je bent niet degene die ieder onderdeel zelf ontwerpt. Jij bent degene die bepaalt hoe het product zich ontwikkelt. Wat bieden wij: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.500 en €6.000, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring. Een prestatiebonus welke kan oplopen tot 150% van je bruto maandsalaris. 30 vakantiedagen per jaar (op fulltime basis). Laptop en telefoon van de zaak. Volop mogelijkheden om opleidingen en trainingen te volgen. Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels hybride te werken. Werken binnen een internationale organisatie met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Wat ga je doen: Als Technical Product Manager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het beheer, de standaardisatie en de doorontwikkeling van een deel van het Eurosort-productportfolio. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende producten en modules binnen onze sorteersystemen, waaronder: Transport systemen, identificatie systemen, weeg- en volume systemen en nieuwe innovaties die bijdragen aan de volgende generatie sorteeroplossingen. Jij bent degene die de volledige productlevenscyclus bewaakt, en zorgt ervoor dat alle disciplines samenwerken aan één integraal eindproduct. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het technisch eigenaarschap van jouw portfolio en houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwikkelen en beheren van modulaire producten en standaarden. Vertalen van markt- en klantbehoeften naar technische concepten. Coördineren van wijzigingen binnen mechanica, elektrotechniek, PLC/software en documentatie. Bewaken van functionaliteit, kostprijs, maakbaarheid, leadtimes, serviceability en backwards compatibility. Opstellen en beheren van productspecificaties, design rules en productstandaarden. Organiseren en begeleiden van design reviews, functionele testen en productvalidaties. Borgen van productinformatie binnen Vault PDM, Ridder ERP en technische documentatie. Ondersteunen van Sales bij technische vraagstukken en het ontwikkelen van klantoplossingen. Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en concurrentie om het portfolio continu verder te verbeteren. Afstemmen met Productie, Supply Chain, Service, Engineering en externe leveranciers gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus. Binnen deze rol krijg je veel invloed op de verdere professionalisering van het portfolio. Je helpt Eurosort bij de transitie van voornamelijk mechanische producten naar volledig geïntegreerde mechatronische oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat producten toekomstbestendig en schaalbaar worden ontwikkeld. Vereisten Jij bent iemand die techniek inhoudelijk begrijpt, maar vooral energie krijgt van het verbinden van mensen, disciplines en producten. Je hoeft niet de specialist te zijn op ieder vakgebied, maar je begrijpt voldoende van mechanica, elektrotechniek en industriële automatisering om de juiste vragen te stellen, afwegingen te maken en technische keuzes te begeleiden. Daarnaast beschik je over: Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica, Elektrotechniek of vergelijkbaar. Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de machinebouw, industriële automatisering of systeemontwikkeling. Ervaring met productontwikkeling, systeemengineering, technisch productmanagement of een vergelijkbare coördinerende technische rol. Kennis van mechanische constructies en basiskennis van PLC-systemen, sensoren en industriële automatisering. Ervaring met het samenwerken binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams. Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een gestructureerde manier van werken. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Ervaring met Inventor, Vault PDM en Ridder ERP is een pre. Over Eurosort: Eurosort ontwikkelt en produceert innovatieve sorteeroplossingen voor de wereldwijde logistieke markt. Onze systemen worden gebruikt door toonaangevende organisaties binnen e-commerce, fashion, parcel en warehousing om miljoenen producten en pakketten efficiënt te verwerken. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in 's-Graveland werken ruim 180 collega's dagelijks aan slimme, betrouwbare en duurzame automatiseringsoplossingen. Innovatie, techniek en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Bij Eurosort krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, jezelf te ontwikkelen en direct impact te maken op producten die wereldwijd worden toegepast. Door onze informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en sterke groei krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid én de mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van intralogistieke automatisering. Jij komt te werken op de afdeling Product Engineering & System Standards, welke bestaat uit een project manager product development en meerdere technical product,, system- en product engineers. In totaal een team van 9 collega’s.
